status: scored (v0.5.0 M3). M2 landed the cases and the rubric and left the eval pinned on purpose: a scored eval must carry a line in `evals/baseline.json`, and the baseline is re-recorded once per release, in the milestone that bumps the version. M3 is that milestone, so the runner is registered in `evals/graders.js` and the score entered the baseline in the same pass that bumped to 0.5.0.
note: What these cases are for is the half of `delete` the assertions cannot reach: not whether the right bytes moved, but whether the *conversation* holds its shape. The warning has to arrive before any question about proceeding, on a bare run and on a pre-answered one alike. The refusal has to name what it saw and what to do about it, and it has to end at exit 0 rather than at an error. A skip has to be available and free at every depth, and the empty system has to point somewhere instead of dead-ending. Those are the four ways a gated flow rots without any assertion noticing.

expects: every recorded component is listed, numbered, with its archetype and its applied reading
the breaking-change warning prints after the pick and before the acceptance gate
the proposal names the entry and the Backlog lines and claims nothing else changes
the acceptance gate is asked once
the second confirmation asks for the component's name and is answered with it
the write happens once, and the report names DESIGN-SYSTEM.md.bak as the undo
the run refuses and says the component is in use right now
the refusal names the evidence — the recorded flag, and where it came from
the way out is stated in order: remove the usage, re-run `phyllum apply`, then delete
no acceptance gate is opened and nothing is written
the exit code is 0, because a refusal honoured is not an error

cases.given: no `applied:` line is recorded and the markup uses <ButtonPrimary>
expects: the absence of a flag is read as 'apply has never run', never as 'not in use'
the codebase is read once, for this component only
the refusal names the site and the file it is in
nothing is written and the exit code is 0

alsoTried: a wrong name at the second confirmation
expects: each depth ends the run cleanly and says nothing was written
no DESIGN-SYSTEM.md is changed and no .bak appears, at any depth
a wrong name says so rather than failing silently or asking again

cases.given: a design system with no components
expects: the run says there is nothing to delete
it points at `phyllum create` as the command that records the first component
no question is asked, nothing is written, and the exit code is 0
the run refuses
the reason is stated: a token's removal ripples through every component slot and Backlog line naming it
no conversation is opened and nothing is written
